$comment: Push-rejection classification conformance vectors (betterbase-sync-core::push_policy::classify_push_rejection). Frozen server contract: (rejection source, error code) -> client disposition. The disposition drives quarantine accounting (only 'permanent' counts), conflict reconciliation (pull then re-push once), and batch-capacity backoff. Run by the Rust unit tests (push_policy), the browser tests (real wasm classifyPushRejectionCode), and the node tests (TS mirror in js/src/db/sync/sync-manager.ts). Matching is case-sensitive and exact; unknown codes must classify as 'transient' — an unrecognized code must never quarantine a record. Changes to this table are a protocol change: server + every SDK.
